name: Construction variation review assistant
why: Checks a variation request against the signed contract and prices without approving it, the same stance as the change log in the RFIs and changes skill.

name: Prepare a construction variation decision
why: A clause map, cost check and decision brief for one variation, for the client's fresh yes in the change and payment workflow.

name: Prepare a construction defects handover
why: A defects register with owners and closure evidence, for the snagging and handover stage after the programme ends.

name: Weekly project delay evidence assistant
why: A weekly delay trend brief, a useful second look at the delay log before the client report.

name: Trace why work keeps missing deadlines
why: Finds repeated causes of slips from records, like reading the reasons for missed look-ahead tasks.

name: Weekly status update writer
why: A one-page done, stuck and needed update, a quick base for the weekly client report.

name: Weekly meeting actions keeper
why: Minutes and open actions for the weekly site or progress meeting.

name: Supplier quote table builder
why: Puts two or more supplier quotes in one table, handy for materials alongside the builder quote check.

name: Check capacity before promising a delivery date
why: Checks crew capacity and date options before a builder promises a start or finish date.

name: Construction funding draw planner
why: Plans how build costs are funded across periods, for clients with a construction loan who need the payment timeline.

name: Construction funding evidence reviewer
why: Rechecks draws and remaining funding when build costs or dates change after a delay.

name: Compare facilities service contract options
why: Side-by-side contractor proposals with plain-words terms, the same method as the quote check, for shop and office owners.
